The '''Polordio system''' was located in the [[Danjar sector/Legends|Danjar sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the substance known as [[Polordion smootdust]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|36|Polordion smootdust}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Polordion smootdust]]|system=Polordio [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Polordio [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-19.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
